data.narrative:
Svante, a Series E climate and energy technology company founded by Brett Henkel, has raised $318M to date. The valuation universe for Climate & Energy spans 9 private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and 1 public comparable (Lanzatech, ticker LNZA). A traditional peer-median approach could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting minimum density thresholds in this sector.

Stage-progression methodology—the sole applicable triangulation method—uses Svante's $318M cumulative capital raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 1.4x step-up multiplier characteristic of Series E advancement. This yields an implied valuation of $445M. The resulting range incorporates downside and upside scenarios: a conservative bound of $378M and an upper bound of $512M, anchored around the median of $445M.

The analysis supports a valuation in the $378M–$512M range, with $445M as the central estimate. Key uncertainties include the limited peer set available for comparative validation—only two adjacent-stage Climate & Energy companies exist in the dataset—and reliance on a single quantitative method. Revenue multiples, cash-burn trajectory, and technology-stage readiness remain unspecified in the provided data and would refine this estimate materially.
